attributes.title: create_proposed_structure
attributes.description: Creates the ENTIRE accepted proposal in one call -- every UDT definition, then every instance, then every standalone tag, batched one gateway write per folder. This is the only tool you need to build the structure; do not create tags one at a time. It reads the proposal back from the database, so what gets built is exactly what the user reviewed -- you do not re-send it. Refuses with status 'not_accepted' until accept_proposal has been called. Returns per-type counts and a 'failures' list; a single bad item does not stop the rest.

parameters.name: proposal_id
parameters.description: Id returned by save_proposal. Omit to build the most recent accepted proposal.
